name: Cauterize
description: At the cost of some of his own Health, Accursed bursts the air around a target, dealing Magic Damage to an enemy or healing an ally.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Target ally: heals 100/150/200/250. Target enemy: deals 100/150/200/250 Magic damage. Self-damage cost: 50/75/100/125 Magic to self. Mana cost 75. Cooldown 6000ms. Range 700.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(6s / 5s) = 2 turns — short cooldown, reflects Accursed's spammy support nature. Damage/heal taken as level-1 values. Self-damage is a cost paid at cast time (reduces Accursed's HP). Targeting: any unit. In card game: if ally → heal + no self-damage immune; if enemy → Magic damage. Self-damage cost is a key risk mechanic — Accursed can whittle himself healing allies. Balance risk: monitor heal efficiency vs self-HP loss ratio.
